description: Full token sheet by contract address or by ticker/name (use rug_check for a short verdict-first answer to "is this a rug?"). Returns the contract address DexSheet tracks, an assessment (passed, new, flagged, failed or unrated, with the reasons and one next_step), a dated automated rug check scored as SheetScore (score 0–95 or null when unrated, band, confidence, five weighted pillars, every check with pillar, status, detail and source, and which wallets were excluded from holder concentration), other tokens using its name or symbol (copycats or bridged versions), a timestamped market snapshot (not live), pools, the DexSheet page URL and, unless the token failed or was flagged, where to buy. When symbol matches span several chains and no chain is given, every match is returned (chain, native/bridged/wrapped, SheetScore, liquidity, URL) with ambiguous: true and no winner; pass a chain or an address for the full check. Within one chain the deepest-liquidity match is checked and the rest are listed in other_matches.

address.description: Contract address. Solana base58 (case-sensitive) or EVM 0x… (any case). "<chain>:<address>" also works, e.g. "robinhood:0x39db…".

chain.description: Optional chain: solana, ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum, robinhood, hyperevm.

symbol.description: Ticker or name, e.g. "FARTCOIN" or "$WIF". Used when no address is given.

name: check_token
title: Check a token: real address, rug check, lookalikes, where to buy
